prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1455; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd prefer to keep my name off this one for now, if that's alright. You can reference the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot in Baytown, Texas, near one of the big retail stores. I had just pulled into a row to find a space.

Q: What were you doing right before impact?
A: I was driving slowly, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I was looking for an open spot on the right side of the lane.

Q: Describe the other vehicle.
A: It was a pickup truck, dark colored. It came out from a parking space on my left, backing up. I didn't see it until it was already in front of me.

Q: Did either of you sound a horn or try to stop?
A: I hit my brakes as hard as I could. I don't think the driver saw me until the last second. I didn't have time to honk.

Q: How did you get hurt?
A: My wrist took the brunt of it. I threw my arm up against the steering wheel and the airbag. The doctor later told me it was fractured.

Q: Did you receive medical treatment?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They X-rayed it and put me in a splint. I have a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble gripping things and I can't drive for long stretches right now. I'd appreciate it if this could be handled promptly.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
